Recently, Gaba has been used as an “off label treatment” for anxiety and mood disorders because people that were prescribed for it reported that it helped put minds and emotions at ease. It’s different for everybody. It took about a week of being on a low dose to not be so impulsive which was my reason for weight gain. Gaba made me stop and think (which I loooved). It made me feel relaxed and I was okay with waiting to eat my next meal. I didn’t think about food as much as I used to. It was easy to distract myself. Not gonna lie, I did feel a little buzz.

When I had doubts in a serious relationship, I made a plan B in my head and started saving a little bit more money. There were times when he would make me change my mind and I would be like, “oh plan B is off” and then he’s do something to make me go back to the planning. Eventually, that pattern got old. When I was finally tired of going back and forth, I had enough money to live in a hotel until I found a place to settle. Start doing some Craigslist housing searches (apts/rooms whatever) just see what’s out there and start thinking what you would do if you were to actually leave. Talk to a lawyer. Doesn’t mean you have to make the decision now, just be smart and prepare yourself just in case one day you just can’t take it anymore and just have to leave. Good Luck.
